# Copilot Instructions

## Repository Overview

This repository contains multi-language SDK clients for the **INFO-Subscription API**, generated via [Microsoft Kiota](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openapi/kiota/) from the OpenAPI spec at `https://api.info-subscription.com/swagger/latest/swagger.json`.

Active SDKs: **.NET** and **TypeScript**. A Python SDK pipeline stub exists in `eng/azure-pipeline.yml` but is not yet wired up.

## Build Commands

Working directory for .NET commands: `dotnet-sdk/`

```sh
dotnet build                                    # build the solution
dotnet pack --configuration Release             # create NuGet package
dotnet run --project Sample/Sample.csproj       # run the sample app
```

Working directory for TypeScript commands: `typescript-sdk/`

```sh
npm install   # install dependencies
npm run build # compile (tsc → dist/)
npm run clean # remove dist/
```

There are no tests in this repository.

## Architecture

```
dotnet-sdk/
  src/
    generated/                              # Kiota-generated — DO NOT edit manually
    ClientConfiguration.cs                  # DI extension methods (AddInfoSubscription)
    ConfidentialClientAuthenticationProvider.cs
    InfoSubscriptionClientFactory.cs
    InfoSubscriptionSettingsOptions.cs
  Sample/                                   # Console app demonstrating SDK usage

typescript-sdk/
  src/
    generated/                              # Kiota-generated — DO NOT edit manually
    infoSubscriptionSettings.ts             # Settings interface
    confidentialClientAuthenticationProvider.ts  # MSAL Node B2C token provider
    tenantHeaderMiddleware.ts               # Injects S4-TenantId on every request
    infoSubscriptionClientFactory.ts        # createInfoSubscriptionClient() factory
    index.ts                                # Public API barrel export
  package.json
  tsconfig.json

eng/
  azure-pipeline.yml    # ADO pipeline: regenerates all SDKs from the latest OpenAPI spec
  package-nuget.yml     # ADO pipeline: packs and publishes the .NET NuGet package
```

## Key Conventions

### Generated code is off-limits
Both `dotnet-sdk/src/generated/` and `typescript-sdk/src/generated/` are regenerated by the `azure-pipeline.yml` CI pipeline. Never edit these files manually. To expose additional API endpoints, add `--include-path` patterns to the `kiota generate` commands in the pipeline (and update the corresponding `kiota-lock.json`).

### .NET — DI registration
Two registration paths:
- `services.AddInfoSubscription(configuration)` — registers both the client and Azure AD B2C auth in one call.
- `services.AddClientFactory(configuration)` + `services.AddApiAuthentication(configuration)` — register separately to swap out one part.

### .NET — Configuration sections
| Section | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `InfoSubscription:ApiEndpoint` | Base URL (default: `https://api.info-subscription.com`) |
| `InfoSubscription:TenantId` | Tenant GUID sent as `S4-TenantId` request header |
| `Adb2cSettings:ClientId` | Azure AD B2C app client ID |
| `Adb2cSettings:B2CTenantName` | Azure AD B2C tenant name |
| `Adb2cSettings:ClientSecret` | Client secret for M2M auth |
| `Adb2cSettings:SignInPolicy` | B2C sign-in policy (default: `B2C_1A_V2SIGNIN`) |
| `Adb2cSettings:ScopeName` | API scope name (default: `api`) |

### .NET — HTTP resilience
Polly is wired in automatically (5 retries on transient HTTP errors) via `AddTransientHttpErrorPolicy`. Do not add additional retry logic in consuming code.

### TypeScript — Client creation
No DI framework. Use the `createInfoSubscriptionClient(settings)` factory function from `src/index.ts`. It wires up MSAL Node (B2C M2M), the `TenantHeaderMiddleware`, and Kiota's `FetchRequestAdapter` internally.

### TypeScript — Authentication pattern
- `ConfidentialClientAuthenticationProvider` implements Kiota's `AccessTokenProvider` using `@azure/msal-node`'s `ConfidentialClientApplication` — mirrors the .NET class exactly.
- `TenantHeaderMiddleware` implements Kiota's `Middleware` interface and injects the `S4-TenantId` header at the front of the middleware chain before the default Kiota handlers.
- The generated TypeScript client entry point is `createInfoSubscription(requestAdapter)` in `src/generated/infoSubscription.ts` (a factory function, not a class).

### Versioning and releasing
[MinVer](https://github.com/adamralph/minver) (.NET) and `npm version` (TypeScript) both derive the package version from git tags. Both SDKs share the same version — pushing a single semver tag (e.g. `1.2.3`) to `main` triggers both pipelines simultaneously.

`package-nuget.yml`: **Pack → PublishInternal (ADO NuGet feed) → Deploy (NuGet.org + GitHub Release)**

`package-npm.yml`: **Pack → PublishInternal (ADO npm feed) → Deploy (npmjs.org)**

See `RELEASE.md` for the full process and required pipeline secrets (`NUGET_APIKEY`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `NPM_TOKEN`). Internal feeds (`S4/Internal`) authenticate via the build agent identity.

### Target framework (.NET)
`net10.0` — see `dotnet-sdk/global.json` for the pinned SDK version.
